item.title: Hiring freeze, layoffs possible in Lowell fiscal 2027 budget
item.description: LOWELL — The city of Lowell is preparing for a worst-case scenario for its upcoming budget season, advising its department heads to be “conservative” with their fiscal 2027 budget requests and warning of hiring freezes and personnel reductions.

item.title: Fitchburg payroll correction
item.description: Fitchburg Mayor Samantha Squailia's salary was $119,999.88 in 2025, and the city's police chief, Steven Giannini, was paid $226,480. The entire payroll for is available online at sentinelandenterprise.com.

item.title: Beacon Hill Roll Call: New rules for AI-generated election ads
item.description: The House, 157-0, approved a bill that would require that any synthetic media audio or video communication intended to influence voting must disclose at the beginning and end of the communication that it contains AI-generated materials.
